mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_status_outbox( event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, 0, 0, NOW(3) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, sending_at, lease_token, last_error, created_at, sent_at FROM video_status_outbox WHERE status = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE video_status_outbox SET status = 2, sent_at = #{sentAt}, sending_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 1 AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}

UPDATE video_status_outbox SET status = 0, retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = NOW(3), sending_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, last_error = '发送租约超时，已自动恢复' WHERE status = 1 AND sending_at < #{expiredBefore}
